headline.text: Plastic shavings found at *two* lines — L2 ML2 mold wear and L1 S3 bin-frame contact — both addressed with cleaning and process controls.

summary: One active hold for insufficient salt on L1 S4. Two foreign-material events: L2 ML2 found plastic shavings from mold wear in catch trays, cleaned and monitored; L1 S3 chocolate buildup caused MD bin scraping, producing plastic shavings, floor cleaned and added to CILT. One sanitation gap: L1 cleaning crew missed lower pipe removal.

holds.title: Partial pallet held for insufficient salt
holds.summary: Partial pallet of S4 product placed on hold due to insufficient salt distribution on finished pieces.

food_safety.title: Plastic shavings from MD bin scraping metal frame
food_safety.summary: S3 metal detector bin scraping against frame due to chocolate buildup on floor under wheels, causing plastic to break off and fall into bin; product runs through MD again after rejection.
food_safety.status: Floor cleaned, buildup removed, bin clearance restored; added to CILT checklist to prevent recurrence.

food_safety.title: Plastic shavings from mold wear found in catch trays
food_safety.summary: Plastic pieces found at bottom of ML2 catch trays near demolder, believed to be shavings from mold wear; no product contamination observed as material was outside mold area.
food_safety.status: Catch trays cleaned out, line running, monitoring frequency increased per FSQA direction.

quality.title: S4 pump speed changed below spec by operator
quality.summary: Unidentified Kitchen operator reduced caramel pump speed (Hz) below established parameters, causing cooling in hopper and intermittent emptying with excessive holes in caramel.
quality.status: Resolved — pump settings restored to correct values, system running properly.

quality.title: Truffle guillotine cutting issue causing misshapen pieces
quality.summary: Guillotine not cutting properly, pieces moving out of place causing doubles and misshapen pieces affecting Cavannas; operators suspect temperature too cold.
quality.status: Resolved — tunnel 1 temperature increased, belt wear identified as root cause per maintenance.

quality.title: ML4 broken bars at demolder
quality.summary: Broken bars demolding on ML4; pulse duration adjusted from 350ms to 320ms; EE inspection stations in place after demolder and Gandola, checkweigher verified to reject underweight broken bars.
quality.status: Controlled — pulse duration adjusted, multi-layer inspection and weight rejection in place.

sanitation.title: Lower pipes not removed during cleaning
sanitation.summary: Lower pipes on line equipment were not removed during cleaning shift as required by SOP.
sanitation.status: Open — flagged to Dakota Adair and Jody Howse for follow-up with cleaning crew.

opportunities.text: Consider adding MD bin area floor cleaning to daily CILT — based on today's plastic shavings event where chocolate buildup caused bin-frame contact.
Review Kitchen operator training on pump speed parameter limits — based on today's unauthorized adjustment that caused caramel quality issues on S4.
Consider visual mold wear inspection at start of ML2 shift — based on today's plastic shavings found in catch trays believed to be from mold degradation.
Review ML4 demolder pulse duration settings and add to startup verification — based on today's broken bars issue that required mid-shift adjustment.
